<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

This change introduces support for a new machine configuration node condition type called `InternalReleaseImageDegraded`. A new `StateProgress` enum constant is added to the Go types to represent this state. Documentation is updated across multiple CustomResourceDefinition manifests to list this condition as a valid type available when the `NoRegistryClusterInstall` feature gate is enabled. Generated Swagger documentation is also updated to reflect the new condition type. No schema structure modifications or validation logic changes were made.

</details>
